public class E {
    static long MOD = 998244353L;
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long N = Long.parseLong(tokenizer.nextToken());
        long M = Long.parseLong(tokenizer.nextToken());
        long L = Long.parseLong(tokenizer.nextToken());
        long R = Long.parseLong(tokenizer.nextToken());

        long total = N * M;
        BigInteger totalExp = BigInteger.valueOf(total);
        BigInteger baseRange = BigInteger.valueOf(R - L + 1);
        BigInteger modulus = BigInteger.valueOf(MOD);

        long result;
        if (total % 2 == 1) {
            result = baseRange.modPow(totalExp, modulus).longValue();
            System.out.println((result + MOD) % MOD);
        } else {
            result = baseRange.modPow(totalExp, modulus).longValue();
            if ((R - L) % 2 == 0) {
                result++;
            }
            long invTwo = power(2, MOD - 2, MOD);
            result = (result * invTwo) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    public static long power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1L;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
